title: A Little Girl Was Mailed To Her Grandma 📮
caption:
A little girl was MAILED to her grandma 📮
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. In 1914 an Idaho family paid 53 cents in parcel post stamps to send their daughter to her grandmother. She rode in the train's mail car, looked after by a relative who was a mail clerk. The Post Office soon banned mailing people.
Who would you mail? 👇
first_comment: 53 cents to ship a kid across Idaho. Cheaper than a babysitter. Would you? 📮👇
